title: Unicon grading verdict
description: What the harness posts back through the callback at the end of a run. The forge repo checks it against this schema and keeps it on the gradings row; nothing else stores it. The callback it is posted to, and that callback's token, say which grading it is for. One shape for every task: an outcome from a fixed list, metrics as named numbers, one row per test with its own outcome, time, memory and metrics, a summary for the contestant and the log pointer. There is no separate score. Whatever number a task is ranked on is a metric the leaderboard names, so a scorer that emits points and one that emits accuracy are the same shape.

then.description: Nobody graded: the harness could not run the plan, a primitive broke, or a step could not start. Nothing about the submission is known, so there are no rows and no metrics, and the summary says what went wrong for staff to read.

schema_version.description: The verdict shape this file is written against.

outcome.description: The result of the whole run, from the fixed list every task shares. accepted: every test passed. partial: some did, and the metrics say how much. wrong_answer, time_limit, memory_limit, output_limit, runtime_error: the first failing kind, decided by the workflow's own rule. compile_error: the submission did not build, which is a normal result. system_error: the harness could not grade at all, and staff should look; never a grade.

metrics.description: Named numbers the workflow measured over the whole run, for example points, accuracy or max_time_ms. A leaderboard ranks on one of these by name. Numbers only, so a board can sort them.

tests.description: One row per test the plan ran, in plan order, each with its own outcome, time, memory and metrics. Empty when the workflow has no per-test structure, for example a single-metric evaluation.

summary.description: A few lines for the contestant, as the task's visibility rules allow them to be shown. For a system error, what went wrong, for staff.

log.description: Where the run log went: the object URL the log was written to, without the presigned query, so the forge repo can find it in unicon-results. Null when the log could not be written.

test.description: One row of the per-test table.

id.description: The test's name as the task spells it.

outcome.description: This test's result, from the same list as the run's. skipped: not run, because an earlier test or step made it pointless.

time_ms.description: Wall clock for this test, or null when the step was not measured. Explicitly null rather than absent, so an absent measurement is a statement and not an oversight.

memory_kb.description: Peak memory for this test, or null when the step was not measured.

metrics.description: Named numbers for this test alone, for example its points.

message.description: The checker's note, shown next to the row when the stage allows it.
